product_purpose: Start at most the first currently displayed ordinary Recommended Research row per daily reset, only from idle Queue 1 with every current prerequisite met and all exact Food, Wood, Steel, and Gas costs affordable; use row Research only to open detail and the detail Research control to start.

postconditions: Only the current bound Research Center route is used from canonical Home.
The exact Research Center screen is recognized before any row is selected.
Queue 1 is positively recognized idle before eligibility; a busy, unknown, or occupied queue defers.
The first currently displayed Recommended Research row is bound by its current identity and exact position.
Only position 1 is selected.
The row Research control navigates to that row’s detail; it does not start research.
Every current prerequisite is positively known; unmet prerequisites and shortages take the explicit defer branch, while unknown facts block.
Exact current costs and balances are independently observed for Food, Wood, Steel, and Gas; each balance-to-cost comparison is recorded.
No start eligibility is inferred from an unknown prerequisite, cost, balance, or Queue 1 state.
Every deficient ordinary resource and exact observed shortfall is durably recorded.
No Research input, resource box, gathering, purchase, or technology substitution occurs.
Every current prerequisite is met and every exact Food, Wood, Steel, and Gas balance covers its matching current cost.
Queue 1 is idle and the reset-scoped one-start attempt quota is unused.
A shortage never reaches this state; only this fully affordable first recommendation may proceed to detail Research.
Only the detail Research control for the bound first recommendation is used once.
Current exact prerequisites, costs, balances, and Queue 1 idle evidence are rechecked immediately before dispatch.
Research Now, Diamonds, Queue 2, Activate, boxes, purchases, alternate technology, substitutions, and gathering are excluded.
A current Queue 1 successor identifies the same technology and a positive remaining timer.
All four ordinary resource debits reconcile independently; dispatch alone is not success proof.
Attempt and confirmed-start counts are reconciled under the current reset identity; no identical retry.
The route-owned source-bound return reaches current canonical Home.

cost_quantity_requirements.notes: Use exact current ordinary-resource prices and independently observed balances for all four resources; there is no numeric cost cap or premium substitute.

cooldown_deferred_behavior: Defer when Queue 1 is busy, the reset-scoped start is already attempted or confirmed, or any exact ordinary resource balance is short; record the precise shortages and preserve partial attempt-versus-confirmed state.
bounded_recovery_behavior: Fail closed on unknown or changed row identity, prerequisites, cost, balance, Queue 1, detail binding, start result, or canonical Home. Never select a later row, use a substitute, retry an unresolved start, spend Diamonds, activate Queue 2, inspect Daily, or attribute points.
evidence_requirements: Current source-bound native evidence for first displayed row identity, idle Queue 1, every prerequisite, exact four-resource costs and balances, row Research navigation, detail Research dispatch, resource debit, same-identity Queue 1 timer successor, attempt-versus-confirmed persistence, reset identity, and canonical Home.

Negative evidence must demonstrate no Research Now/Diamonds, Queue 2/Activate, boxes, purchases, alternate technology, substitutions, gathering, Daily/D02, points attribution, or identical retry. No native acceptance or capture identifier is asserted.

replay_fixture_requirements.notes: No synthetic fixture or prior observation substitutes for current source-bound native start and successor evidence.

unsupported_or_manual_only_states: unknown or insufficient ordinary resource balance

required_evidence: The complete current native evidence set listed in evidence_requirements, including precise reset identity and durable attempt-versus-confirmed reconciliation.

scenarios.notes: This is a disabled, evidence-gated contract. Typed policy lists only the route-owned input classes; this scenario authorizes no runtime input until the native gate is satisfied.
